verdict.rationale: Porkbun is a domain-registrar SaaS/API product, not an agent host or IDE that itself consumes external MCP servers' tools. Evidence shows Porkbun ships its own official MCP server (docs-6, docs-31) for other clients like Claude/Cursor to plug into it — the reverse of this story, which asks whether Porkbun can plug in and use other MCP servers' tools. That directionality is a category error for this kind of product.
